_style_anchor: Flat vector style, sharp clean edges, solid flat colors, no gradients, no glow, no blur, no noise, no 3D rendering, no photograph. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
_palette: ATR brand palette: navy #003976, gold #EFAB00, midnight #00295F, sky #2C8ECD, mist #F3F6FA, line #D6DEE8, white #FFFFFF.

bg-title-A.prompt: Abstract geometric presentation background, wide landscape orientation (wider than tall, 16:9). A solid deep navy blue field, hex #003976, fills the entire image. The LEFT 55% of the image is completely empty plain navy: no shapes, no lines, no gradient, nothing. On the RIGHT third only: crisp thin gold (#EFAB00) line-work forming an open wireframe lattice of equilateral triangles and 45-degree chevrons, like a technical robotics blueprint, with two or three thin sky-blue (#2C8ECD) accent lines and a few small solid gold triangles.
